summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) announcing daily purchases of its own ordinary shares under its existing buyback programme announced 31 July 2026, executed through broker Goldman Sachs International. Purchases on 5-9 October 2026 totaled roughly 98.5 million shares at volume-weighted average prices of 100.87-105.22 pence (highest 105.90p, lowest 99.68p), with the shares to be cancelled. The programme runs under Article 5(1)(b) MAR assimilated law. Watch execution pace, cancellation-driven share count reduction, and buyback completion versus capital return guidance.
